Local adaptation notice:
The Conductor of the Guild implements the PCG-XSH-RR 64/32 reference
algorithm in C#. The local adaptation provides explicit constructor-based
seeding, a saved-state record and restore operation, and unbiased bounded
integer selection. It does not include the C implementation's global RNG.
This notice records the adaptation; it is not an upstream NOTICE file.
